keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (NEC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Deveron Fonville (NEC) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! NEC 1, Rennes 0. Bryan Linssen (NEC) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Goal! NEC 1, Rennes 1. Adrien Thomasson (Rennes) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sebastian Szymanski.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Delay in match because of an injury Clement Bischoff (NEC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, NEC 1, Rennes 1.
Adrien Thomasson (Rennes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Abdelhamid Aït Boudlal (Rennes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, NEC. Gabriel Brás replaces Tobias Storm.
Delay in match because of an injury Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Rennes. Issa Soumaré replaces Estéban Lepaul.
Substitution, Rennes. Mousa Al Tamari replaces Boulaye Dia.
Goal! NEC 2, Rennes 1. Tjaronn Chery (NEC) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Rennes. Eliezer Mayenda replaces Sebastian Szymanski.
Substitution, Rennes. Henrick Do Marcolino replaces Djaoui Cissé.
Willum Willumsson (NEC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Rennes. Ludovic Blas replaces Abdelhamid Aït Boudlal.
